paper_records.title: AM-GCN: Adaptive Multi-channel Graph Convolutional Networks
paper_records.saved_takeaway: Two independent specific GCNs process topology and feature-kNN graphs; one Common-GCN uses the same per-layer weights on both graphs, averages its embeddings, then attention-fuses common and specific embeddings before one supervised classifier. Consistency of normalized embedding Gram matrices and HSIC disparity supplement CE.
paper_records.sharing_accuracy_evidence_limit: The inspected Section 4.3 variants remove/change consistency and disparity constraints while retaining the architecture; they do not isolate tied versus untied Common-GCN weights.
paper_records.relationship_to_candidate: Direct prior for sharing feature transformations across distinct graph evidence with view-specific capacity. Not a served predictive-member ensemble with persistent equal-class/different-class TRAIN edge deletion trajectories.

quality_hypothesis.statement: Persistent members receiving complementary same-class-support deletion and different-class-neighbour deletion views can learn reusable native-graph feature channels through a tied body, while private factors retain distinct neighbourhood responses; this can improve native pooled accuracy over otherwise matched untied copies.
quality_hypothesis.helps_if: The views remove different nuisance dependencies while the useful channel semantics remain compatible, and native CE anchors those semantics to the served graph.
hurts_if: Class-discordant edges convey useful heterophilous/boundary evidence.
Equal-class deletion removes scarce legitimate support or affects low-degree/rare-class nodes disproportionately.
TRAIN-label-defined topology becomes a fitting shortcut unavailable in the same form on the served native graph.
A shared compromise suppresses a beneficial member-specific direction or makes native errors more correlated.
quality_hypothesis.decisive_comparator: Tied persistent versus untied persistent with the same complete TRAIN labels, fixed views, native/probe passes, objective reduction, initialization correspondence, private capacity, recipe, selector and native inference pool.
quality_hypothesis.graph_attribution: Compare tied-minus-untied pooled-accuracy difference on targeted views against the same difference for budget-matched random deletion. Persistent versus balanced temporal reassignment addresses member-trajectory persistence, a different causal question.
quality_hypothesis.shuffle_clarification: The amendment balances two members/view at every update and each member across both views within each even-length stage. It is a temporal trajectory intervention; the initial warning about a mere fixed global slot permutation does not apply.
quality_hypothesis.scientific_disposition: Retain as an unresolved accuracy hypothesis, with sharing/view/persistence ingredients attributed. No new generic penalty or gate is proposed.

second_candidate_boundary: AM-GCN does not establish a TRAIN-only one-step pooled-loss choice of mean-preserving private-head covariance in a graph-error span.
